title: Static Lullaby
style: Alt-pop synth-pop, ~108 BPM, steady pulsing groove; low, dark lower-register lead opening into powerful full-voice belts, soft vocoder beneath the layered synth chorus and whispered vocoder outro; pulsing arpeggiated synths, sidechained pads, drums dropping out in the final chorus before slamming back in.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Three a.m., the room hums low
Someone says my name, so slow
Same old phrase, familiar tone
Is it a memory or a ghost on loan?
Lists on the ceiling, a hundred things to do
Sleep’s on the list, but it’s never due

[Pre-Chorus]
It sounds like somebody I know
It sounds like somewhere I’ve been
But the hallway’s empty, and the lights are low
So who let the echo in?

[Chorus]
Oh, it feels so real, it feels so real
A static lullaby I can’t conceal
Is it a memory? Is it a mind that’s wearing thin?
Hold the line, hold the line, let the morning in
Oh, it feels so real, it feels so real
But I’m running on empty, and I’m starting to feel
The voices blur when the night runs long
Maybe I need to sleep to know what’s wrong

[Verse 2]
Coffee for breakfast, coffee for lunch
Running on fumes and a half-made hunch
I say I’m fine, I’ve got too much to do
But the voice in the dark sounds a lot like you
I test it like a joke, then I test it like a prayer
Is anyone really there?

[Pre-Chorus]
It sounds like somebody I know
It sounds like somewhere I’ve been
But the clock keeps ticking, and the lights are low
And the echo’s wearing thin

[Chorus]
Oh, it feels so real, it feels so real
A static lullaby I can’t conceal
Is it a memory? Is it a mind that’s wearing thin?
Hold the line, hold the line, let the morning in
Oh, it feels so real, it feels so real
But I’m running on empty, and I’m starting to feel
The voices blur when the night runs long
Maybe I need to sleep to know what’s wrong

[Bridge] (stripped back, just pads and a low pulse)
Duérmete ya, que el ruido no es real
Vi ses i morgon, I’ll be fine, I’ll heal
Let the phone go dark, let the list go slack
The voices fade out when I lie on my back

[Final Chorus] (drums drop out, then slam back in)
Oh, it feels so real, but I’m closing my eyes
Let the static lullaby be my last goodbye
If it’s still there in the light of day
I’ll ask somebody who can help me say
It’s real to me, it’s real to me
But I’m going to sleep, and we’ll see, we’ll see

Outro (fading arpeggio, vocoder whisper)
Vi ses... vi ses...
Goodnight, goodnight, goodnight
